2610.13722.title: Enhancing Legal Reasoning in Pre-trained Language Models via Knowledge Graph-Guided Multi-Task Pre-training
2610.13722.paper_summary: Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. We evaluate our approach across nine Transformer-based encoders and 324 experimental runs. On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.
2610.13722.paper_summary_zh: 法律語言理解需要對半結構化的監管文件進行推理，但標準的預訓練目標並未明確針對這一結構能力。由於當前的法律語言模型僅依賴於掩蔽語言建模，它們將法規文本視為平坦的標記序列，並忽略了潛在的層次約束。為了彌補這一差距，我們提出了一種針對德國交通法（StVO）的多任務預訓練方法。我們的方法結合了三個互補的目標：下一句預測（NSP）、知識圖譜（KG）引導的聚類（CLU）和知識圖譜（KG）感知的段落分類（CLS）。這種方法明確地將結構化的法律知識編碼直接融入模型權重中。這種編碼使得在推理時能夠進行零樣本法律推理，並消除了離散圖遍歷的需求。我們在九個基於Transformer的編碼器和324次實驗運行中評估了我們的方法。在合成的StVO問題回答中，我們的模型在基準線上顯示出一致的相對改進，介於10.3%到155.0%之間。此外，相對於既定的LexGLUE基準（Chalkidis et al., 2022），我們的模型在七個法律基準中的四個上改善了先前的結果。它在奧地利駕駛規則上也實現了一致的零樣本轉移增益，介於3.4%到15.8%之間。這些實驗結果表明，我們的訓練方法成功地超越了初始訓練法律領域的泛化能力。
